query:
UPDATE source_material
             SET title = $2,
                 title_english = $3,
                 title_japanese = $4,
                 type = $5,
                 status = $6,
                 score = ROUND($7::float8::numeric, 2),
                 chapters = $8,
                 volumes = $9,
                 updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1
